title: 第十六章 妖丹
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
传授完功法，又嘱咐小狐狸按时服用丹药，季南北便开始享用这熊掌了。

    唉，这烤熊掌，多么令人愉悦的享受啊。

    据说，熊在冬眠时会不断舔舐自己的脚掌，使得唾液渗入掌中，因此熊掌肉质格外细嫩鲜美。

    而眼前这只黑熊，更已具备筑基期修为，肉质不仅更上层楼，且蕴含些许灵气，显得尤为美味。

    季南北尝了一口，口感软糯而富有弹性，滋味更是十分鲜醇。

    总而言之就是好吃。

    小狐狸与季南北同步发出了满足的喟叹。一边吃着，季南北忽然想起一件事。

    这筑基期的妖兽......似乎会凝结妖丹。

    想到这里，季南北加快速度吃完了爪中的熊掌，朝洞外走去，再次来到黑熊尸体旁。

    将一枚练气散服下，季南北的灵气已恢复大半，且在食用熊掌后，隐隐有突破至练气二层的迹象。

    再次施展《狐动九斩》第一式，斩击划出，在黑熊腹部切开一道口子。

    伤口一开，季南北便瞧见了其中闪烁的微光。

    探出爪子，季南北向内一掏，再取出时，爪中已多了一枚枣子大小的赤色圆珠。

    那便是黑熊的妖丹。因为这黑熊刚入筑基期不久，凝成的妖丹也并不大。

    不过季南北也是头一回见到妖丹，捏着这弹丸似的物件，他思忖着该如何使用。

    就在此时，小狐狸却忽然开口道:

    “吞下去。”

    季南北一愣，这小狐狸的语气怎么听着有点不对劲?

    “苏千雪?”

    向来敏锐的季南北，没有选择立刻吞服，反倒唤了小狐狸一声。

    “嗯嗯?前辈怎么啦?”

    这回，语气恢复正常了。

    季南北皱起眉头。

    “方才你有没有说话，或者有其他特别的感觉?““啊?好像突然又多了一些知识，不过以前也常这样。前辈，这妖丹好像可以直接吞服，对身体有益处的。”

    季南北应了一声。

    这小狐狸果然有些古怪，刚才那一瞬间流露的语气与气势，完全与这小家伙平日不相符。
content_en:
After teaching the skills and instructing the little fox to take the elixir on time, Ji Nanbei began to enjoy the bear's paw.

    Oh, this roasted bear paw, what a delightful treat.

    It is said that bears will constantly lick their paws during hibernation, allowing saliva to seep into the paws, so the meat of the bear paws is particularly tender and delicious.

    The black bear in front of him has already reached the foundation-building stage. The meat quality is not only better, but also contains a little spiritual energy, which makes it particularly delicious.

    Ji Nanbei took a bite and found that the taste was soft, waxy and elastic, and the taste was very fresh and mellow.

    All in all, it's delicious.

    The little fox and Ji Nanbei let out satisfied sighs simultaneously. While eating, Ji Nanbei suddenly remembered something.

    This demonic beast in the foundation building stage... seems to be able to condense demonic elixirs.

    Thinking of this, Ji Nanbei speeded up and finished eating the bear paws in his paws, walked out of the cave, and came to the black bear carcass again.

    After taking a Qi Lian Powder, Ji Nanbei's spiritual energy had recovered to the majority, and after eating the bear's paw, there were faint signs of breaking through to the second level of Qi Lian.

    He once again performed the first move of "Fox Moves Nine Slashes" and slashed out, cutting a gash in the black bear's abdomen.

    As soon as the wound was opened, Ji Nanbei saw the flickering light inside.

    Ji Nanbei stretched out his claws and dug them inward. When he took them out again, there was a red ball the size of a date in his claws.

    That is Black Bear’s demon elixir. Because this black bear has just entered the foundation building stage, the demon core it has condensed is not large.

    However, it was also the first time for Ji Nanbei to see the demon pill. Holding the projectile-like object, he thought about how to use it.

    At this moment, the little fox suddenly said:

    "Swallow it."

    Ji Nanbei was stunned. Why did this little fox's tone sound a little wrong?

    "Su Qianxue?"

    Ji Nanbei, who was always keen, did not choose to swallow it immediately. Instead, he called the little fox.

    "Hmm? What's wrong, senior?"

    This time, the tone returned to normal.

    Ji Nanbei frowned.

    "Did you speak just now, or have any other special feelings?" "Ah? It seems that you suddenly gained more knowledge, but it was always like this before. Senior, it seems that this demon pill can be swallowed directly and is good for the body."

    Ji Nanbei responded.

    This little fox is indeed a little weird. The tone and momentum he showed at that moment are completely inconsistent with this little guy's usual routine.
